cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

real_world_analog.summary: SQL injection in a WordPress email plugin: a filter parameter reached the statement by string building, enabling UNION extraction (CWE-89).
real_world_analog.fix: Build the statement with bound parameters instead of string formatting; this case uses an equivalent containment (parameter plus no string building).
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search on 2026-11-01; the app in this case is original synthetic code.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Proven directly with effect='canary_sql'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the code is original synthetic code written for this case.
license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: removing spaces does not stop a UNION built with tabs; the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
